title: Bounds to electron spin qubit variability for scalable CMOS architectures
platform: silicon MOS quantum dots; interface roughness variability
claims: Atomic-scale interface roughness contributes to spin-qubit variability.
claim_boundary: Do not assume CMOS heritage eliminates qubit variability.

title: Industrial 300 mm wafer processed spin qubits in natural silicon/silicon-germanium
claims: Industrial 300-mm processing supports platform comparison and process feedback.
claim_boundary: Industrial process progress does not remove platform-specific tradeoffs.

title: A crossbar chip for benchmarking semiconductor spin qubits
claims: Crossbar arrays can support scalable characterization and benchmarking of spin-qubit tiles.
claim_boundary: Benchmarking architecture, not proof of full-scale useful quantum computation.
